notes: «[307/10] الكافي:» is a modern compilation quoting al-Kafi: its compiler is not a transmitter and is not written in the text, so none is added; the quoted book's author is the open point (rule 11)
«أنه سأل أبا عبدالله عليه السلام» — Hisham is the asker and the Imam, named in words after the chain, is the last link (owner ruling 2; rule 5)
